amazon-reference.title: AWS conditional inventory updates and multi-region limits

problems.title: Database as a service
problems.problemStatement: Design a hosted CockroachDB service. Explain how customers deploy it and how operators secure, monitor and recover it.

steps.name: Deployment
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will a customer provision and connect to a database?

steps.name: Operations
steps.interviewerPrompt: Which failures require an alert, an automatic recovery, or a human response?

steps.name: Isolation
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will tenants, access permissions and backups remain isolated?

problems.title: Your project architecture
problems.problemStatement: Diagram a project you know deeply. Explain its design choices and the limits you encountered.

steps.name: Request path
steps.interviewerPrompt: Trace one user action through the components you operated.

steps.name: Failure
steps.interviewerPrompt: Which failure actually occurred, and what changed afterward?

steps.name: Tradeoffs
steps.interviewerPrompt: Which design choice would you change at ten times the original load?

problems.title: Paginated API
problems.problemStatement: Design a website’s paginated results API and its database access.

steps.name: Contract
steps.interviewerPrompt: What does the client send and receive for the next page?

steps.name: Changing data
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will inserts and deletions affect page boundaries?

steps.name: Scale
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will the design avoid scanning and returning the entire dataset?

problems.title: Realtime chat
problems.problemStatement: Design scalable realtime messaging between users.

steps.name: Delivery
steps.interviewerPrompt: Trace a message from its sender to its recipient.

steps.name: Disconnection
steps.interviewerPrompt: What happens when the recipient disconnects and reconnects?

steps.name: Reliability
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will retries affect ordering and duplicate delivery?

problems.title: Data center replication
problems.problemStatement: Design replication between data centers without relying entirely on a database’s built-in replication.

steps.name: Writes
steps.interviewerPrompt: Where does a write become accepted, and who receives its updates?

steps.name: Partition
steps.interviewerPrompt: What happens when the link between data centers fails?

steps.name: Recovery
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will replicas catch up and resolve conflicting changes?

problems.title: Saved search emails
problems.problemStatement: Let book shoppers save search terms and receive a daily email about matching new listings.

steps.name: Matching
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will a new listing find the searches it matches?

steps.name: Digest
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will matches become one daily digest per subscriber?

steps.name: Retries
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will a failed delivery retry without sending the same digest twice?

problems.title: Round robin load balancer
problems.problemStatement: Build a round robin load balancer with retries, health tracking and circuit breaking.

steps.name: Routing
steps.interviewerPrompt: How does a request choose a healthy destination?

steps.name: Failures
steps.interviewerPrompt: When should a retry choose a different server?

steps.name: Recovery
steps.interviewerPrompt: How does an unavailable server safely rejoin traffic?

problems.title: Subscription payments
problems.problemStatement: Design subscription payments with multiple payment options and safe handling of repeated requests.

steps.name: Lifecycle
steps.interviewerPrompt: How do signup, renewal and cancellation change subscription state?

steps.name: Idempotency
steps.interviewerPrompt: What happens when a client or payment provider sends the same event twice?

steps.name: Reconciliation
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will you recover when payment succeeds but local state was not updated?

problems.title: Threaded comments and voting
problems.problemStatement: Design a discussion platform supporting deeply nested comment trees and live upvote/downvote tallies.

steps.name: Tree Storage
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will you model and query deeply nested comment trees with high read throughput?

steps.name: Vote Aggregation
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will you handle hot-post vote storms without overwhelming the database with write locks?

steps.name: Ranking Delivery
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will you compute top and best comment rankings and stream updates to connected clients?

problems.title: Global video streaming and CDN
problems.problemStatement: Design an adaptive bitrate video streaming service delivering high-throughput playback globally.

steps.name: Ingest and Encoding
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will raw video uploads be split into chunks and encoded into multiple bitrate streams?

steps.name: Edge Caching
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will tiered CDN caching and prefetching minimize buffer stalls in regional networks?

steps.name: Manifest Delivery
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will player clients dynamically adapt bitrate during network degradation?

problems.title: Realtime social timeline
problems.problemStatement: Design a real-time social timeline where users follow accounts and receive fresh home feeds.

steps.name: Fanout
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will you balance fanout-on-write against fanout-on-read for high-follower celebrity accounts?

steps.name: Timeline Cache
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will home timelines be stored, bounded, and evicted in memory?

steps.name: Delivery
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will active connected clients receive new tweets in real time without polling?

problems.title: Ephemeral stories media pipeline
problems.problemStatement: Design ephemeral photo and video stories that replicate to friends and expire in 24 hours.

steps.name: Media Processing
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will uploaded images and videos be processed, stored, and replicated across regions?

steps.name: Audience Routing
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will friend privacy graphs and viewed-state tracking determine story tray order?

steps.name: Expiration
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will media and metadata be automatically purged upon reaching their 24-hour TTL?

problems.title: Flash sale inventory reservation
problems.problemStatement: Design an e-commerce checkout system handling high-concurrency item reservation without double-selling.

steps.name: Reservation
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will the system reserve stock atomically under extreme checkout concurrency?

steps.name: Idempotency
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will duplicate payment webhooks and retried checkout submissions be prevented?

steps.name: Timeout Recovery
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will uncompleted reservations safely expire and return inventory to available stock?

problems.title: Distributed web crawler
problems.problemStatement: Design a scalable web crawler that traverses billions of web pages while honoring politeness.

steps.name: URL Frontier
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will the URL frontier manage prioritization, politeness queues, and deduplication?

steps.name: Fetch Workers
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will distributed fetchers handle DNS caching, timeouts, and robots.txt rules?

steps.name: Index Handoff
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will crawled document content be parsed, fingerprinted, and handed off to indexing?

problems.title: Distributed presence broker
problems.problemStatement: Design a real-time presence service broadcasting user availability across enterprise channels.

steps.name: Heartbeat Ingest
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will the service track keep-alive heartbeats and detect client disconnections?

steps.name: Status Fanout
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will status transitions fan out efficiently to channels and active contact lists?

steps.name: Bulk Sync
steps.interviewerPrompt: How will desktop and mobile clients sync bulk presence states on initial login?
